title: Install a Python package with pip
summary: Use pip to install Python libraries and tools. You can install them for your user only or system-wide.

steps.explain: Install the specified package. By default, pip installs to the system-wide location, which may require administrator rights. To install only for your current user, use the --user flag.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Name of the Python package to install

alternatives.explain: Install the package to the user's directory instead of the system-wide default location. This avoids permission errors and does not require sudo.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Name of the Python package to install

rollback.explain: Uninstall the package if you no longer need it.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Name of the Python package to uninstall

warnings: Installing system-wide may require sudo. Using --user is safer for beginners.
On some modern Linux distributions, system-wide pip installation is blocked by default (externally-managed-environment).
